en.name: Marinus II
en.summary: A pope who continued to serve under Alberic II's secular rule while attending to charitable works and church repairs in Rome.
en.body: Marinus II, sometimes called Martin III in older sources, governed entirely within the framework of Alberic II's control of Roman civic affairs, devoting his attention chiefly to distributing alms and repairing Roman churches rather than any independent political initiative.
